answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Warranted credit controller registration with credit management attestation. It requires a registration management officers renew after ledger audits, so the haven of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The garden is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The violet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
